source.finding: Native fixed/dynamic value slots are traced before the custom class trace hook; a hook early return on undefined Listeners does not omit the Symbol slot.
Slot span is at least JSCLASS_RESERVED_SLOTS, including a property-less native prototype.
Public slot APIs validate class slot range in debug and SetReservedSlot applies GC barriers for GC-valued writes.

owner: The existing EventTarget::proto_obj object owns the new SymbolValue slot; the selected JS factory also holds normal traced closure references. No additional static/PersistentRootedSymbol is introduced.
initialization: Initialize actual prototype first; only then allocate rooted description/Symbol and store with barrier. Failure returns false and no key is published to registration.
lookup: Check prototype root initialized/non-null and slot isSymbol; getter makes no allocating call; caller immediately initializes RootedSymbol before any property lookup/JS evaluation.
layout: Selected EventTarget::Slots::Count becomes2; AbortSignal::ParentSlots and Reason compute2. All repository C++ TUs plus real external embedding must share derived macro, not only EventTarget/register.
teardown: Current Engine has no explicit destructor/context shutdown protocol; singleton intent does not prove a general native embedding teardown contract. This proposal adds no independent native root and makes no broader teardown fix claim.
